title: SiTime Corporation to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 4, 2026

# SiTime Corporation to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 4, 2026


October 07, 2026


SANTA CLARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Oct. 7, 2026--[SiTime Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sitime.com%2F&esheet=54617856&newsitemid=20261007354264&lan=en-US&anchor=SiTime+Corporation&index=1&md5=7a4fed785a0590d6ee9ebcc630147a6c) (Nasdaq: SITM), the Precision Timing company, will announce its third quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026, after market close.


Rajesh Vashist, chief executive officer, and Beth Howe, chief financial officer, will broadcast a conference call at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time to discuss the company’s results.


Analysts and investors are invited to join the conference call using the following information:


Date: **Wednesday, November 4, 2026** Time: **2:00 p.m. Pacific Time** (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time)
Live webcast:[Click Here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.media-server.com%2Fmmc%2Fp%2F7os8kgmd&esheet=54617856&newsitemid=20261007354264&lan=en-US&anchor=Click+Here&index=2&md5=99a84e0f25d9e852be03e2a3fd180c76) **** Register for dial-in number:[Register Here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fregister-conf.media-server.com%2Fregister%2FBI9dec58d4e3bf46159f26ed1a793fd635&esheet=54617856&newsitemid=20261007354264&lan=en-US&anchor=Register+Here&index=3&md5=d5968bd82e2692c01474be67e0cba3a1)


Advanced registration is required for dial-in participants. Please complete the linked registration form above to receive a dial-in number and dedicated PIN for accessing the conference call. A live audio webcast of the conference call will also be available and archived for approximately 90 days in the[Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.sitime.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fevents&esheet=54617856&newsitemid=20261007354264&lan=en-US&anchor=Events&index=4&md5=09f114d5ff76d0e9aac3c8742135da6d) section of SiTime’s Investor Relations website.


**About SiTime**


SiTime Corporation is the Precision Timing company. Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit[www.sitime.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.sitime.com%2F&esheet=54617856&newsitemid=20261007354264&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sitime.com&index=5&md5=b33c7c5287356ec767359dd42e5c3e06) .


**About Precision Timing**


Timing is the heartbeat of all electronic systems, ensuring reliable operation over their lifetime. For decades, quartz-based devices, built on non-semiconductor technology, have delivered this critical function, but they struggle in harsh, demanding environments. SiTime’s Precision Timing, based on semiconductor MEMS technology, delivers superior performance, greater resilience, smaller size and higher reliability. Today, it powers more than 400 applications, including those in high-growth segments such as AI data centers, industrial and humanoid robots, mobile, wearables, IoT and automated driving.
